name: One More Chance
summary: One More Chance is a polyomino block puzzle for iPhone and iPad built around a board-game idea. Each round two shapes of 1 to 7 cells are revealed, and every player picks one and places it on their own 9×9 board, rotating or flipping it. If neither shape fits, the player takes "one more chance": a shape drawn just for them; if that one does not fit either, they are out. The player who leaves the fewest empty cells wins. Everyone plays at the same time. Modes include solo play, a Daily Challenge with the same shapes for everyone, pass-and-play on one device for 2 to 6 players, local play on several phones over Bluetooth and Wi-Fi without internet, and online tables for up to four players. The game has 9 visual themes, medals, 200 levels and VoiceOver support, in 12 languages.
